decisions.reason: As a visible 2023 launch with its own page, a positive agency-oriented signal, and strong fit with the firm's announced push into compliance capabilities, management is likely to justify continued commitment rather than withdraw it.

Because this platform is prominently featured on the home page across both years and sits at the center of the firm's agency-focused hosting direction, escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.

This configurable managed hosting plan is close to the core business, remained on its own page in both years, and is easy for management to defend as a strategic extension that still needs time to mature.

Although less visibly committed than the other launches, it is very new, tied to the firm's security and support strengths, and management can readily attribute any weak uptake to short-run adoption rather than product failure.
